onbHomeWelcomeBody: Yi magana da kowa, a kowane harshe. Maganarka tana zama rubutun fassara kai tsaye da murya da aka fassara — nan take, a kowane kira.
onbHomeStartBody: Saita sunanka da harshenka, sannan ka shigar da lambar daki don buɗe daki ko shiga na aboki. Danna Shiga daki kuma ka shiga.
onbHomeTiersBody: Standard yana ba ka rubutun fassara kai tsaye da murya da aka fassara cikin araha. Manyan matakai suna fassara da sauri kuma da inganci. Canza a kowane lokaci kafin kira.
onbHomeCreditsBody: Kira yana cire daga ragowarka a kowane minti, ga kowane harshen fassara. Cika a kowane lokaci da Saya kuɗi — ragowarka koyaushe tana bayyana a sama.
onbHomeGuestBody: Fara magana a matsayin baƙo yanzu. Shiga don adana tarihin kiranka, rubuce-rubucenka da kuɗinka a duk na'urori.
wizWebinarBody: Karɓi baƙuncin webinar kai tsaye kuma bar masu sauraronka su bi shi cikin harshensu tare da fassara nan take. Ƙirƙirar webinar na buƙatar biyan kuɗi na Business ko Enterprise mai aiki.

onbHomeCtaBody: Wannan shi ne yawon. Saita harshenka, zaɓi daki ka kuma yi sallama. Sake buɗe wannan jagora a kowane lokaci daga maɓallin "?".
